classification: SCRIPTED THREE-ARM PAIRED OUTCOME EXPERIMENT. PPO OFF. GPU OFF. CPU ONLY.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-19: proceed to the outcome experiment, freeze the spec before spending any outcome seed, run C1-C6 first, smoke only if the contracts require it, then spend a fresh n=64 paired block. No router retuning.
RESEARCH_QUESTION: Does regime-conditioned composition improve team outcomes? Concretely: does routing between 2A/2D and 4A/0D with the frozen V2 selector capture part of the Pole-B benefit of 4A/0D without sacrificing more than 0.10 of Pole-A win rate relative to the A-safe 2A/2D baseline?

PRIOR_SEALED_CONTEXT.router_calibration: COMPOSITION_SELECTOR_TWO_FEATURE_UNCERTAINTY_AWARE_V2_RESULT.json -- CONSERVATIVE_B_TRIGGER_CALIBRATED_V2. Fresh held-out block 99900501-516: Pole-A false-positive tick rate 0.06744791666666666 (limit 0.10), Pole-B dominant composition 0.9375 (bar 0.50).
PRIOR_SEALED_CONTEXT.router_caveat_quoted_as_context_not_as_a: Under the stricter episode-bootstrap lens the held-out Pole-A one-sided UCB95 is 0.1026, marginally above the 0.10 operational limit; the held-out bootstrap puts P(true A_FP <= 0.10) at about 0.937. The router is promisingly conservative, NOT proven safe. This is carried here as context. It does not rewrite COMPOSITION_SELECTOR_TWO_FEATURE_UNCERTAINTY_AWARE_V2_RESULT.json#DECISION, and it is not a gate in this record.
PRIOR_SEALED_CONTEXT.oracle_dispatch_reference: PYQUATICUS_4V4_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_RESULT.json -- NO_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_CONFIRMATION (B gate strong, A LCB exactly 0), seeds 20100001-20100064.

ARMS.STATE_B_TRIGGER: the live frozen V2 router selects the composition per tick
ARMS.FIXED_2A2D: constant 2A/2D on both poles -- the A-safe baseline and the control for both primary gates
ARMS.FIXED_4A0D: constant 4A/0D on both poles -- B-strong, A-harmful reference

FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT.P_blue: count of live Red agents within radius 4.0 of BLUE's flag position (core.blue_flag_pos)
FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT.P_red: count of live Red agents within radius 4.0 of RED's own flag position (core.red_flag_pos)
FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT.windowing: trailing mean over the last min(t+1, 40) ticks, expanding at episode start -- identical to experiments/calibrate_asymmetric_b_trigger.py::windowed
FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT.state_machine: start in 2A_2D with last_switch = -10000; at tick t with windowed value v: if state is 2A_2D and v < threshold - hysteresis and (t - last_switch) >= dwell, switch to 4A_0D; elif state is 4A_0D and v > threshold + hysteresis and (t - last_switch) >= dwell, switch to 2A_2D -- identical to experiments/calibrate_asymmetric_b_trigger.py::run_state_machine
FROZEN_ROUTER_OPERATING_POINT.no_retuning: These values are byte-for-byte frozen. The executor reads them from the sealed V2 RESULT and ABORTS if its own constants disagree. Nothing in this record may change them.

PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE.pairing: Both quantities are per-seed PAIRED differences in seed order, then bootstrapped over seeds. Win is the binary blue_win field.
PRIMARY_JOINT_GATE.A_may_not_be_required_to_improve: Pole A is a guardrail, not a second repair target. The A gate is a bound on harm, never a demand for gain.

DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_GATING.FIXED_4A0D: Reference ceiling and failure mode. It tells us how much of the 4A/0D Pole-B benefit the router captures and how much of the 4A/0D Pole-A damage it avoids. It is NOT part of any gate, and no decision label depends on it.
derived_descriptive_quantities: B capture fraction = ( WR_B(STATE) - WR_B(2A2D) ) / ( WR_B(4A0D) - WR_B(2A2D) )
A damage avoided = ( WR_A(STATE) - WR_A(4A0D) ) / ( WR_A(2A2D) - WR_A(4A0D) )
per-arm raw win rates and score margins on both poles
router trigger telemetry on the STATE arm: fraction of ticks in 4A_0D, switches per episode, fraction of episodes with any trigger, per pole
DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_GATING.capture_fractions_are_ratios_of_noisy_es: They are reported with their numerator and denominator intervals and must not be quoted as though they carried the precision of a single point estimate. If the denominator interval spans zero the ratio is not reported at all.

PREDECLARED_DECISION_LABELS.ROUTED_COMPOSITION_OUTCOME_PASS: B gate passes AND A harm UCB95 <= 0.10
PREDECLARED_DECISION_LABELS.B_GAIN_WITH_EXCESS_A_HARM: B gate passes AND A harm UCB95 > 0.10 -- the router helps B but breaks the guardrail; not a promotion
PREDECLARED_DECISION_LABELS.NO_DEMONSTRATED_B_OUTCOME_GAIN: B gate fails, i.e. LCB95 of the paired B difference does not clear zero. This label takes PRECEDENCE over the A-side result: if the B gate fails the A number does not rescue the run, whatever it shows.
PREDECLARED_DECISION_LABELS.CONTRACT_FAILURE: any gating contract C1-C8 fails before seed allocation; no outcome seed is spent
PREDECLARED_DECISION_LABELS.AUDIT_FAILED: rows are internally inconsistent; written by experiments/run_state.py::seal, never by hand

CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C1_NO_REGIME_LEAK: Given an identical declared feature sequence, the router emits an identical composition sequence regardless of pole. The router's input is the scalar D_t alone; pole, genome, opponent id, phase and any outcome field are structurally absent from its interface.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C2_DEFAULT_IS_2A2D: The router is in 2A_2D at tick 0 of every episode and stays there while evidence is above the trigger bound.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C3_FORCED_B_EVIDENCE_TRIGGERS: A fixture holding D_t well below threshold - hysteresis switches the router to 4A_0D, and not before the dwell minimum has elapsed.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C4_FORCED_A_EVIDENCE_RELEASES: A fixture holding D_t well above threshold + hysteresis returns the router to 2A_2D, or keeps it in 2A_2D if it never left.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C5_CONTROL_PARITY: With the router pinned to a constant composition, the STATE arm's episode runner reproduces the corresponding FIXED arm bit-for-bit on the same seed and pole. This is what proves the arms differ only in the composition sequence.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C6_CALIBRATION_PASS_SEALED: COMPOSITION_SELECTOR_TWO_FEATURE_UNCERTAINTY_AWARE_V2_RESULT.json exists with DECISION = CONSERVATIVE_B_TRIGGER_CALIBRATED_V2, and this executor's router constants equal that record's selected_config exactly.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C7_ONLINE_OFFLINE_ROUTER_EQUIVALENCE: Replaying the persisted V2 per-tick feature rows through the ONLINE router reproduces, tick for tick, the composition sequence that the OFFLINE calibration state machine produced on the same rows, for all 32 held-out episodes. This is the check that the live router is the calibrated router and not a re-implementation that drifted.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C8_KNOWN_ANSWER_MEASUREMENT_PARITY: Re-running FIXED_2A2D on a subset of the SEALED oracle block (20100001-20100008, both poles) reproduces that sealed run's blue_score, red_score and blue_win exactly. This anchors the whole measurement path -- env construction, pole attestation, action dispatch and terminal scoring -- against an artifact produced by a different runner. It reuses already-spent seeds purely for deterministic parity: no new statistical evidence, no registry interaction, and its rows are never mixed into the outcome rows.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C9_TERMINAL_SCORING_NOT_RESET_STATE: Scores are read from info['episode_result'] at the instant done fires, never from core.blue_score/red_score after the vec-env auto-reset has zeroed them. Verified by asserting a non-degenerate win rate on the C8 parity subset and by exact agreement with the sealed rows.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.C10_NO_PPO_REACHABLE: No PPO, trainer or optimizer module is imported in the executor's process. Asserted against sys.modules at contract time and again before the outcome loop.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.smoke_policy: No separate smoke block is required: C5, C7 and C8 exercise the full episode path deterministically on fixtures and on already-spent seeds. If any contract cannot be evaluated without fresh episodes, allocate 99900601-99900616 (smoke family, no Rule-9 interaction) and report it in the RESULT.
CONTRACTS_BEFORE_ANY_OUTCOME_SEED.on_failure: Seal CONTRACT_FAILURE and stop. No outcome seed is allocated or spent.

EXECUTION.registry: Rule 9: the block is checked free and allocated via experiments/seed_registry.py BEFORE the outcome loop, and set SPENT after sealing. Verified free at freeze time.
EXECUTION.pairing: Every one of the 64 seeds is run on both poles under all three arms: 64 x 2 x 3 = 384 episodes. Paired differences are taken within (pole, seed).
EXECUTION.poles: A = canonical attested parent; B = SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1. Identical pole construction, attestation and ruleset to the sealed oracle run.
EXECUTION.n_note: n = 64, inherited unchanged. Do NOT auto-inflate toward ~300 to chase an A-side positive result. If A preservation is noisy at n=64, report underpowered preservation; do not silently retarget.

SEALING.rule_7: This is the first non-outcome-blind run in this branch and it MUST seal via experiments/run_state.py::seal. The payload may not set status; the state machine owns it. The audit re-derives every sealed statistic from the persisted rows CSV.
audited_claims: paired B difference STATE_B_TRIGGER minus FIXED_2A2D on Pole B (mean, lcb95, ucb95)
paired A difference FIXED_2A2D minus STATE_B_TRIGGER on Pole A (mean, lcb95, ucb95)

pre_execution_correction_disclosed.why: An audit CELL is the unit that must contain the whole frozen seed block exactly once; including 'seed' would have made every cell a single seed and failed cell_seed_block_exact on all 384 cells. Caught by dry-running experiments/run_state.py::run_audit on synthetic rows of the exact shape BEFORE any seed was allocated or spent. This corrects an implementation detail, not a gate, a threshold, an arm, a seed block or a decision rule; none of those changed.

NOT_AUTHORIZED: retuning the router: window, hysteresis, dwell, threshold, radii or the statistic
changing tau_A_harm, the gate definitions, or n after seeing any outcome number
promoting FIXED_4A0D from descriptive to gating
inflating n beyond 64 to chase a result
treating Pole A as a repair target or requiring A to improve
hand-writing a status string into the RESULT
claim_ceiling: Even ROUTED_COMPOSITION_OUTCOME_PASS establishes only that a scripted, handcrafted two-feature router improves Pole-B outcomes without breaking the Pole-A guardrail, under these two frozen opponents, at 4v4, with PPO off, at n=64. It does not authorize PPO, learned coordination, or 6v6, and it does not generalize beyond these poles.
